description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the acquisition of Land in Pitakandewatta, Balapitiya  D/S Division, Galle District and 7 others
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically dealing with compensation deposits for acquired lands. The notices include detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (names, plan numbers, lot numbers, extents, and locations), which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification for land acquisitions and property-related matters.
